name: Situation F final — dual-branch gated latent residual
training_scope: same as Situation E: seeds 100-115 in nominal/wind3/force_step/model20
test_seeds: 2200-2299, 100 paired seeds per scenario, not used in prior experiments
architecture: frozen exact Situation-E current-only latent path + separate 100-ms history encoder + bounded dynamic latent gate
capacity_control: same side architecture receives current temporal triplet instead of lagged triplet
coherence_control: same trained history model with lag permuted across paired seeds at test
direct_concat_control: exact Situation-E-style 6->45->3 concatenation control retrained deterministically

success_criteria.incremental_history: positive paired CI vs exact current-only in >=4 of 7 stressed regimes, nominal degradation <2%
success_criteria.history_specificity: positive paired CI vs matched current-side capacity control in >=4 of 7 stressed regimes
success_criteria.temporal_coherence: positive paired CI vs shuffled history in >=4 of 7 stressed regimes
